description: V2 — Advanced SentinelOne Singularity Data Lake / AI SIEM dashboard for global IP connection intelligence, all-country traffic visibility, geographic attribution, inbound exposure, outbound communications, protocols, ports, endpoint/process attribution, and policy-defined restricted/elevated-risk geographies.

graphs.title: Readme
graphs.markdown:
# Global Network Intelligence — Geo Connections & Exposure | V2

This dashboard turns **SentinelOne IP Connect telemetry** into an analyst-focused network intelligence view for SOC operations.

## Primary use cases
- Identify **outbound connections** by destination country, remote IP, protocol, port, endpoint, process, and user.
- Identify **inbound connections** by source country, source IP, destination endpoint, service port, and process.
- Provide **all-country traffic visibility** across every geolocatable remote country observed in the selected time range.
- Rank countries, IPs, endpoints, processes, users, protocols, and ports by observed connection volume.
- Investigate policy-defined restricted/elevated-risk geographies.
- Surface network activity involving **remote administration, lateral-movement, database, and other security-sensitive service ports**.
- Pivot from geography → endpoint → process through Sankey visualizations.
- Provide raw event tables for investigation and evidence collection.

## Important interpretation notes
- Country attribution is derived from public IP geolocation using `geo_ip_country()`.
- Private, loopback, link-local, or otherwise non-geolocatable addresses may not produce a country value.
- NAT, proxies, VPNs, CDNs, cloud egress, and security gateways can change the apparent country associated with a connection.
- A connection to a restricted or monitored country is **not by itself evidence of malicious activity**. Geography is a policy/risk signal that requires endpoint, process, port, user, and Storyline context.
- Event counts are connection-event counts, not guaranteed unique TCP/UDP sessions.
- This dashboard is based primarily on `event.type == "IP Connect"` telemetry collected by SentinelOne-protected endpoints.

## V2 policy-defined restricted / elevated-risk geographies
The **Restricted Geographies** tab monitors the following country set:

**Tier 1 — Persistent state-sponsored / strategic cyber threat focus**
- Russia
- China
- Iran
- North Korea / DPRK
- Belarus

**Tier 2 — Elevated APT monitoring / client risk policy**
- India
- Pakistan
- Vietnam

The list is intentionally policy-driven and can be customized per client. Country-level monitoring should not be interpreted as attribution of individual traffic to a threat actor.

## V2 all-country visibility
The **Geo Intelligence** tab includes an **All Countries — Unified Traffic Matrix**. It groups all geolocatable inbound and outbound IP Connect events by remote country and direction, including connection volume, unique remote IPs, endpoints, processes, protocols, and observed ports.

## Analytic Priority model
The Restricted Geographies tab includes a **custom analytic score** for triage. This is not a SentinelOne threat score:
- +50: Tier 1 restricted geography
- +35: Tier 2 elevated-monitoring geography
- +30: security-sensitive destination/service port
- +20: script interpreter / LOLBin / command-line utility process

The score is intended only to prioritize analyst review.

## V2 query compatibility fix
The **Monitored Geography Activity Over Time** visualization uses a full Power Query with `timebucket()` and `transpose` instead of dashboard regular-search plot filters. This avoids using `geo_ip_country()` in a regular-search plot filter, where that function is not supported.

Developed by the Threat Detection Engineering Division at NeverOff Technology (SentinelOne Division)
Dominican Republic

graphs.title: Total IP Connect Events
graphs.description: Total IP Connect telemetry in the selected time range.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count()

graphs.title: Outbound Connections
graphs.description: Connections initiated by protected endpoints.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING") | group Connections = count()

graphs.title: Inbound Connections
graphs.description: Connections observed as incoming to protected endpoints.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "INCOMING") | group Connections = count()

graphs.title: Distinct Remote Countries
graphs.description: Distinct geolocated remote countries observed.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteCountry = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(RemoteCountry) | group Countries = estimate_distinct(RemoteCountry)

graphs.title: Distinct Remote Public IPs
graphs.description: Distinct remote IPs for which country geolocation is available.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address | let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP) | filter !isempty(RemoteCountry) | group RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(RemoteIP)

graphs.title: Endpoints with Network Activity
graphs.description: Protected endpoints generating IP Connect telemetry.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name)

graphs.title: Network Connections Over Time
graphs.description: Outbound and inbound IP Connect activity over the selected time range.

graphs.title: Connection Direction
graphs.description: Distribution of IP Connect events by direction.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count() by event.network.direction | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Network Protocols
graphs.description: Observed protocol distribution across IP Connect telemetry.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count() by event.network.protocolName | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Connection Status
graphs.description: Distribution of connection status values reported by endpoint telemetry.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count() by event.network.connectionStatus | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Top Remote Countries
graphs.description: Highest-volume geolocated remote countries across inbound and outbound connections.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteCountry = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(RemoteCountry) | group Connections = count() by RemoteCountry | sort -Connections | limit 15

graphs.title: Top Sites by Network Activity
graphs.description: Sites producing the most IP Connect telemetry.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count() by site.name | sort -Connections | limit 20

graphs.title: Top Endpoints by Network Activity
graphs.description: Endpoints ranked by IP Connect event volume.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count(), RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(dst.ip.address) by endpoint.name, endpoint.os, site.name | sort -Connections | limit 20

graphs.title: Top Outbound Destination Countries
graphs.description: Countries receiving the most outbound connections from protected endpoints.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING") | let DestinationCountry = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | filter !isempty(DestinationCountry) | group Connections = count(), DistinctRemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(dst.ip.address), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by DestinationCountry | sort -Connections | limit 30

graphs.title: Top Inbound Source Countries
graphs.description: Countries associated with the source IPs of incoming connections.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "INCOMING") | let SourceCountry = geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(SourceCountry) | group Connections = count(), DistinctSourceIPs = estimate_distinct(src.ip.address), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name) by SourceCountry | sort -Connections | limit 30

graphs.title: Outbound Country Distribution
graphs.description: Percentage distribution of outbound connections by destination country.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING") | let DestinationCountry = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | filter !isempty(DestinationCountry) | group Connections = count() by DestinationCountry | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Inbound Country Distribution
graphs.description: Percentage distribution of incoming connections by source country.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "INCOMING") | let SourceCountry = geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(SourceCountry) | group Connections = count() by SourceCountry | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Country Activity by Endpoint
graphs.description: Endpoints and remote countries ranked by observed connection volume.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteCountry = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(RemoteCountry) | group Connections = count() by endpoint.name, RemoteCountry, event.network.direction | sort -Connections | limit 40

graphs.title: Geo Flow — Country → Endpoint → Process
graphs.description: Sankey view showing which remote countries connect with which endpoints and which local processes are associated with the activity.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let country = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(country) | let host = "💻 " + endpoint.name | let proc = src.process.name != null ? "⚙️ " + src.process.name : "⚙️ System/Kernel" | group c = count() by country, host, proc | sort -c | limit 60 | let link = array(0,1,2).expand() | let source = link == 0 ? "🌐 Global Network" : link == 1 ? country : host | let target = link == 0 ? country : link == 1 ? host : proc | group c = sum(c) by source, target | columns source, target, c

graphs.title: Top Remote IPs with Geographic Context
graphs.description: Remote IPs ranked by connection volume with direction, country, ports, and endpoint reach.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address | let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP) | filter !isempty(RemoteCountry) | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Ports = array_agg_distinct(dst.port.number) by RemoteCountry, RemoteIP, event.network.direction | let DistinctPorts = array_to_string(Ports, ", ") | columns RemoteCountry, RemoteIP, event.network.direction, Endpoints, DistinctPorts, Connections | sort -Connections | limit 100

graphs.title: All Countries — Unified Traffic Matrix
graphs.description: Complete country-level traffic matrix across all geolocatable inbound and outbound IP Connect events. No country allowlist/restricted-list filter is applied.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING"))
| let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address
| let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP)
| filter !isempty(RemoteCountry)
| group Connections = count(), UniqueRemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(RemoteIP), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name), ProtocolsArray = array_agg_distinct(event.network.protocolName), PortsArray = array_agg_distinct(dst.port.number) by RemoteCountry, event.network.direction
| let Protocols = array_to_string(ProtocolsArray, ", ")
| let Ports = array_to_string(PortsArray, ", ")
| columns RemoteCountry, event.network.direction, Connections, UniqueRemoteIPs, Endpoints, Processes, Protocols, Ports
| sort -Connections

graphs.title: Monitored Geography Events
graphs.description: Total IP Connect events involving the V2 restricted/elevated-risk geography set.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND ((event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" AND geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")) OR (event.network.direction == "INCOMING" AND geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")))) | group Connections = count()

graphs.title: Endpoints Involved
graphs.description: Distinct endpoints involved in monitored-geography network activity.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND ((event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" AND geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")) OR (event.network.direction == "INCOMING" AND geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")))) | group Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name)

graphs.title: Unique Remote IPs
graphs.description: Distinct remote IPs geolocated to restricted/elevated-risk countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address | let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP) | filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | group RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(RemoteIP)

graphs.title: Outbound Monitored
graphs.description: Outbound connections to restricted/elevated-risk countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" AND geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")) | group Connections = count()

graphs.title: Inbound Monitored
graphs.description: Incoming connections from restricted/elevated-risk countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "INCOMING" AND geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")) | group Connections = count()

graphs.title: Monitored Geography Activity Over Time
graphs.description: Restricted/elevated-risk geography connection trend by network direction. V2 uses Power Query so geo_ip_country() is evaluated in the query pipeline rather than an unsupported regular-search plot filter.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING"))
| let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address
| let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP)
| filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")
| group Connections = count() by timestamp = timebucket('1 hour'), Direction = event.network.direction
| transpose Direction on timestamp

graphs.title: Restricted / Elevated-Risk Countries
graphs.description: Distribution of traffic involving the V2 restricted/elevated-risk geography set.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteCountry = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | group Connections = count() by RemoteCountry | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Top Endpoints — Monitored Geographies
graphs.description: Endpoints with the highest volume of connections involving restricted/elevated-risk countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteCountry = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | group Connections = count(), Countries = array_agg_distinct(RemoteCountry) by endpoint.name, endpoint.os, site.name | let CountryList = array_to_string(Countries, ", ") | columns endpoint.name, endpoint.os, site.name, CountryList, Connections | sort -Connections | limit 25

graphs.title: Top Processes — Monitored Geographies
graphs.description: Processes associated with the most monitored-geography network events.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteCountry = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Countries = array_agg_distinct(RemoteCountry) by src.process.name, src.process.publisher | let CountryList = array_to_string(Countries, ", ") | columns src.process.name, src.process.publisher, Endpoints, CountryList, Connections | sort -Connections | limit 25

graphs.title: Security-Sensitive Ports — Monitored Geographies
graphs.description: Connections involving restricted/elevated-risk countries and ports commonly associated with remote administration, lateral movement, databases, or management services.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND dst.port.number in (22,23,135,137,138,139,445,3389,5900,5901,5902,5903,5985,5986,1433,1434,1521,3306,5432,6379,27017,9200,9300) AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address | let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP) | filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(RemoteIP) by RemoteCountry, dst.port.number, event.network.protocolName, event.network.direction | sort -Connections | limit 50

graphs.title: Top Remote IPs — Monitored Geographies
graphs.description: Most active remote IPs geolocated to restricted/elevated-risk countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address | let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP) | filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Ports = array_agg_distinct(dst.port.number), Processes = array_agg_distinct(src.process.name) by RemoteCountry, RemoteIP, event.network.direction | let PortList = array_to_string(Ports, ", ") | let ProcessList = array_to_string(Processes, ", ") | columns RemoteCountry, RemoteIP, event.network.direction, Endpoints, PortList, ProcessList, Connections | sort -Connections | limit 50

graphs.title: Analytic Priority — Geo + Port + Process
graphs.description: V2 analyst-priority model: +50 Tier 1 geography, +35 Tier 2 geography, +30 sensitive port, +20 script interpreter/LOLBin. This is an analyst-priority score, not a SentinelOne threat score.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING"))
| let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address
| let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP)
| let GeoTier = RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus") ? "Tier 1" : RemoteCountry contains:anycase("india", "pakistan", "vietnam") ? "Tier 2" : "Other"
| let GeoRisk = GeoTier == "Tier 1" ? 50 : GeoTier == "Tier 2" ? 35 : 0
| let PortRisk = dst.port.number in (22,23,135,137,138,139,445,3389,5900,5901,5902,5903,5985,5986,1433,1434,1521,3306,5432,6379,27017,9200,9300) ? 30 : 0
| let ProcessRisk = src.process.name in:anycase('powershell.exe','pwsh.exe','cmd.exe','wscript.exe','cscript.exe','mshta.exe','rundll32.exe','regsvr32.exe','python.exe','python3','bash','sh','curl.exe','curl','wget.exe','wget','certutil.exe','bitsadmin.exe') ? 20 : 0
| let AnalyticScore = GeoRisk + PortRisk + ProcessRisk
| filter AnalyticScore >= 35
| let Priority = AnalyticScore >= 80 ? "Critical Review" : AnalyticScore >= 60 ? "High Review" : "Medium Review"
| columns event.time, site.name, endpoint.name, src.process.user, src.process.name, src.process.publisher, event.network.direction, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, event.network.protocolName, event.network.connectionStatus, RemoteCountry, GeoTier, AnalyticScore, Priority
| sort -AnalyticScore, -event.time
| limit 250

graphs.title: Restricted Geo Flow — Country → Endpoint → Process
graphs.description: Sankey investigation flow for V2 restricted/elevated-risk countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let country = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) : geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter country contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam") | let host = "💻 " + endpoint.name | let proc = src.process.name != null ? "⚙️ " + src.process.name : "⚙️ System/Kernel" | group c = count() by country, host, proc | sort -c | limit 60 | let link = array(0,1,2).expand() | let source = link == 0 ? "🚨 Restricted Geographies" : link == 1 ? country : host | let target = link == 0 ? country : link == 1 ? host : proc | group c = sum(c) by source, target | columns source, target, c

graphs.title: Raw Restricted / Elevated-Risk Geography Connections
graphs.description: Detailed V2 restricted/elevated-risk geography events with analyst geography tier for validation and evidence collection.
graphs.query:
| filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING"))
| let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address
| let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP)
| filter RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus", "india", "pakistan", "vietnam")
| let GeoTier = RemoteCountry contains:anycase("russia", "china", "iran", "north korea", "korea, democratic people's republic of", "dprk", "belarus") ? "Tier 1" : "Tier 2"
| columns event.time, event.id, site.name, endpoint.name, endpoint.os, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.name, src.process.displayName, src.process.user, src.process.cmdline, src.process.image.path, src.process.publisher, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, event.network.direction, event.network.protocolName, event.network.connectionStatus, RemoteCountry, GeoTier
| sort -event.time
| limit 1000

graphs.title: Protocols by Connection Volume
graphs.description: Protocol distribution for IP Connect events.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count() by event.network.protocolName | sort -Connections

graphs.title: Top Outbound Destination Ports

graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING") | let DestinationCountry = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | group Connections = count(), RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(dst.ip.address), Countries = array_agg_distinct(DestinationCountry) by dst.port.number, event.network.protocolName | let CountryList = array_to_string(Countries, ", ") | columns dst.port.number, event.network.protocolName, RemoteIPs, CountryList, Connections | sort -Connections | limit 40

graphs.title: Top Inbound Destination Ports
graphs.description: Most frequently targeted local destination/service ports in incoming IP Connect events.

graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND dst.port.number in (22,23,135,137,138,139,445,3389,5900,5901,5902,5903,5985,5986,1433,1434,1521,3306,5432,6379,27017,9200,9300) AND event.network.direction in ("OUTGOING","INCOMING")) | let RemoteIP = event.network.direction == "OUTGOING" ? dst.ip.address : src.ip.address | let RemoteCountry = geo_ip_country(RemoteIP) | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(RemoteIP) by dst.port.number, event.network.protocolName, event.network.direction, RemoteCountry | sort -Connections | limit 100

graphs.description: Endpoints ranked by connection volume and distinct remote IP reach.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING") | let DestinationCountry = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | group Connections = count(), DistinctRemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(dst.ip.address), DistinctCountries = estimate_distinct(DestinationCountry), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name) by endpoint.name, endpoint.os, site.name | sort -Connections | limit 30

graphs.title: Top Network Processes
graphs.description: Processes producing the most IP Connect events.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(dst.ip.address), Ports = array_agg_distinct(dst.port.number) by src.process.name, src.process.publisher | let PortList = array_to_string(Ports, ", ") | columns src.process.name, src.process.publisher, Endpoints, RemoteIPs, PortList, Connections | sort -Connections | limit 30

graphs.title: Users Associated with Network Activity
graphs.description: Users ranked by observed network connection volume.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND src.process.user != null) | group Connections = count(), Endpoints = estimate_distinct(endpoint.name), Processes = estimate_distinct(src.process.name), RemoteIPs = estimate_distinct(dst.ip.address) by src.process.user | sort -Connections | limit 30

graphs.title: Script Interpreters & LOLBins with Network Activity
graphs.description: Network connections associated with command interpreters, scripting engines, download utilities, and commonly abused LOLBins. Context is required; many are legitimate administrative tools.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND src.process.name in:anycase('powershell.exe','pwsh.exe','cmd.exe','wscript.exe','cscript.exe','mshta.exe','rundll32.exe','regsvr32.exe','python.exe','python3','bash','sh','curl.exe','curl','wget.exe','wget','certutil.exe','bitsadmin.exe')) | let DestinationCountry = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | columns event.time, site.name, endpoint.name, src.process.user, src.process.name, src.process.publisher, src.process.cmdline, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, event.network.protocolName, event.network.connectionStatus, DestinationCountry | sort -event.time | limit 300

graphs.title: Endpoint → Process → Destination Country
graphs.description: Sankey flow showing which endpoint processes communicate with which destination countries.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "OUTGOING") | let country = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | filter !isempty(country) | let host = "💻 " + endpoint.name | let proc = src.process.name != null ? "⚙️ " + src.process.name : "⚙️ System/Kernel" | group c = count() by host, proc, country | sort -c | limit 70 | let link = array(0,1,2).expand() | let source = link == 0 ? "🧭 Outbound Endpoints" : link == 1 ? host : proc | let target = link == 0 ? host : link == 1 ? proc : country | group c = sum(c) by source, target | columns source, target, c

graphs.title: Process Network Detail
graphs.description: High-detail process-to-network attribution for investigation.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect") | let DestinationCountry = geo_ip_country(dst.ip.address) | let SourceCountry = geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | columns event.time, site.name, endpoint.name, endpoint.os, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.name, src.process.displayName, src.process.publisher, src.process.cmdline, src.process.image.path, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, event.network.direction, event.network.protocolName, event.network.connectionStatus, SourceCountry, DestinationCountry | sort -event.time | limit 1000

graphs.title: Top Inbound Source IPs

graphs.title: Inbound Flow — Country → Source IP → Endpoint
graphs.description: Sankey view of external source geography, source IP, and targeted endpoint.
graphs.query: | filter(event.type == "IP Connect" AND event.network.direction == "INCOMING") | let country = geo_ip_country(src.ip.address) | filter !isempty(country) | let remoteip = "🌐 " + src.ip.address | let host = "💻 " + endpoint.name | group c = count() by country, remoteip, host | sort -c | limit 70 | let link = array(0,1,2).expand() | let source = link == 0 ?
